findings.title: UI message switched from i18next placeholders to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: This file is consumed by the React account UI, and its other validation messages use i18next double-brace interpolation such as {{0}} and {{1}}. The new value uses single braces and a Java ChoiceFormat expression: Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}. i18next will not substitute {0}/{1}/{2}, so the account UI will display literal placeholders and the raw choice expression instead of the attribute name and count for multi-valued validation errors. Keep the UI placeholder syntax (and localize plural forms using the UI's plural support) rather than copying the server-side MessageFormat string.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next placeholders to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: The admin UI message bundle uses double-brace interpolation (e.g. {{0}}) throughout, but error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed to single-brace Java MessageFormat placeholders plus a ChoiceFormat expression. The admin UI's i18n layer will render the placeholders and choice syntax literally instead of substituting the attribute name and value count, breaking this validation error message in the admin console. The server-side MessageFormat syntax is not valid for this JS resource.

findings.title: Lithuanian account messages replaced with Italian text
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account message bundle was changed to the Italian string 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'. Lithuanian users will now see Italian text on the account TOTP setup page. The replacement needs to be a Lithuanian sentence, not a copy of the Italian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login messages replaced with Italian text
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login message bundle was changed to the Italian string 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'. This makes the Lithuanian login TOTP setup page display Italian text. It should be a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now contains Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The zh_CN (Simplified Chinese) account bundle now has totpStep1 set to '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：', which uses Traditional Chinese characters and vocabulary (手機, 應用程式). This is a regression for Simplified Chinese users; the value should be written in Simplified Chinese.

findings.title: Choice-format normalization erases HTML before sanitization
findings.body: normalizeValue removes the entire {n,choice,...} expression for error-invalid-multivalued-size and linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit* by replacing it with '...'. If a translation places HTML or script inside a choice alternative, that markup is removed from the string handed to the OWASP sanitizer, so the verifier will not report it even though it can be rendered at runtime. This creates a false negative in the exact check the PR is adding. Strip only the choice syntax needed for verification, or validate each choice alternative separately.

findings.title: No positive test for allowed HTML or matching anchors
findings.body:
All four tests only assert that an error is reported for bad fixtures. There is no fixture where valid HTML (for example when English contains , or
) or a matching anchor is expected to produce no message. A regression that rejects every translation containing HTML or anchors would still pass this test suite.
